pages.title: The Cool Food School
pages.description: The Cool Food School was created for fussy eaters, promoting healthy eating in a fun and interactive environment for kids of all ages. We teach cooking and food education in schools and sell cool products like a safe knife and peeler, kids cookbook, Pick Plate, reusable sandwich bags and more.
